event.description:
Saturday Constructed Event 2nd November 12 pm
Entry Fee : Free of Charge
Participation Prizes: 1 Silver Pack
Max Capacity 32 Players
Format : 5 Rounds Constructed Best of 1 Swiss into Constructed Best of 3 Top 4 Single Elimination
Prizes:
5 wins : 1 Gold Pack + 2 Silver Packs
4 wins : 2 Silver Packs
3 wins : 1 Silver Packs
Prizes for 32 players (prize will reduce if we dont hit 32 players)
1st: 1 Silvie Figurine + 1 Silvie Idle Thought Playmat
2nd: 1 Silvie Idle Thought Playmat
3rd: 1 Silvie Idle Thought Promo
4th: 1 Silvie Idle Thought Promo
Prizes for 31 or less players:
1st: 1 Silvie Idle Thought Playmat
2nd: 1 Silvie Idle Thought Promo
